newsitem.title: USA: Hugoton Q4 earnings helped by price rise.
newsitem.headline: Hugoton Q4 earnings helped by price rise.

text.p: Hugoton Energy Corp on Friday said higher product prices and increased oil and gas production pushed earnings and revenues to record levels in the fourth quarter.
The company reported fourth-quarter net income of $3.3 million, or $0.17 a share, compared with a loss of $1.7 million, or $0.09, in the final three months of 1995.
Hugoton Energy said the year-ago results included operating income and interest expense losses totaling $2.6 million.
Revenues in the latest quarter rose to $20.6 million from $13.3 million.
Its shares closed down 7/8 at 11-5/8 on the Nasdaq.
